blocks.p: Chéngdū de zǎoshang lái de hěn màn.

blocks.h: 七点四十，天是淡淡的茶色。
blocks.p: Qī diǎn sìshí, tiān shì dàndàn de chásè.
blocks.e: At seven-forty, the sky is the colour of weak tea.

blocks.p: Kōngqì lǐ yǒu làyóu de wèidao.
blocks.e: The air smells of chilli oil.

blocks.h: 你拉着箱子，走到你的新小区。
blocks.p: Nǐ lā zhe xiāngzi, zǒu dào nǐ de xīn xiǎoqū.
blocks.e: You drag your suitcase to your new housing compound.

blocks.h: 大门口，一个保安拿着保温杯，站在你前面。
blocks.p: Dàménkǒu, yí ge bǎo'ān ná zhe bǎowēnbēi, zhàn zài nǐ qiánmiàn.
blocks.e: At the main gate, a guard with a thermos stands in your way.

blocks.h: 你给他看手机上的合同。
blocks.p: Nǐ gěi tā kàn shǒujī shang de hétong.
blocks.e: You show him the contract on your phone.

blocks.p: Tā yì háng yì háng de kàn.
blocks.e: He reads it line by line.

blocks.h: 他看看你，又看看你的箱子。
blocks.p: Tā kànkan nǐ, yòu kànkan nǐ de xiāngzi.
blocks.e: He looks at you, then at your suitcase.

blocks.h: 然后他指了指物业的小门。
blocks.p: Ránhòu tā zhǐ le zhǐ wùyè de xiǎo mén.
blocks.e: Then he points to the little property office door.

blocks.p: Dàmén pángbiān yǒu yì jiā miànguǎn.
blocks.e: Next to the gate there's a noodle shop.

blocks.h: 老板拿着大勺子，跟你招手。
blocks.p: Lǎobǎn ná zhe dà sháozi, gēn nǐ zhāoshǒu.
blocks.e: The owner waves a big ladle at you.

blocks.h: 物业里面，一位阿姨已经在对你笑了。
blocks.p: Wùyè lǐmiàn, yí wèi āyí yǐjīng zài duì nǐ xiào le.
blocks.e: Inside the property office, a woman is already smiling at you.

blocks.h: 钥匙很重，挂在红绳子上。
blocks.p: Yàoshi hěn zhòng, guà zài hóng shéngzi shang.
blocks.e: The keys are heavy, on a red string.

blocks.h: 听到“五零一”，她的笔停了。
blocks.p: Tīng dào “wǔ líng yāo”, tā de bǐ tíng le.
Chuāngwài de bǎo'ān yě tái qǐ tóu.
blocks.e: Outside, the guard looks up too.

blocks.h: 这时候，一位阿姨拿着一袋绿豆，大声笑着走进来。
blocks.p: Zhè shíhou, yí wèi āyí ná zhe yí dài lǜdòu, dàshēng xiào zhe zǒu jìnlái.
blocks.e: Just then, a woman with a bag of green beans walks in, laughing loudly.

blocks.p: Yuánlái, tā jiù zhù zài nǐ duìmén.
blocks.e: It turns out she lives right across the hall.
